items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: "They imitate it but we're the real McCoy."

ctx.x: I said, 'All you got to do is bring the piano player,' had a good white boy, you know, hell of a piano player, so he come down and in the meantime they had an eight-piece band that played all the basketball games, all the affairs around that school, so she come around -- I dropped this thing on her. I went through the whole repertoire, man, like Peggie just showed me. Her mouth flew open, never closed. She said 'You sing.' I say, 'do I sing. Does a mockingbird,' so I could sing. You know, a young kid, had a nice…

majority of colored person could sing, that's our heritage, singing and dancing, that is our heritage. Don't let nobody kid you. Rhythm, singing and dancing is our heritage. At this later date, they still ain't caught it. They imitate it but we're the real McCoy. You better believe it.
So I laid it on her, and I was all up on the popular songs. I laid a couple of them on her too. She said, 'you got the job.'
